text:
Nina Park: Quick proposal for the upcoming Recognition Sprint (next Friday-Sunday): set up a small "popcorn & kudos" table in the main lobby + a remote-friendly nomination form that triggers spot awards for distributed folks. Thoughts?
Ethan Cole: sounds fun. remote folks need shipping option for physical swag/gift cards. can we do digital + mailed variants?
Sofia Martinez: we can. vendor supports both physical cards and e-gift codes. shipping addresses will need to be collected securely.
Ravi Desai: procurement note: any physical swag > $100 per person triggers inventory tagging. prefer digital for simplicity.
Nina Park: ok digital-first. we'll reserve 30 printed mini-ceremony cards for in-person folks.
people-bot: Reminder: to issue a spot award use `/issue-spot-award <recipient> <amount> <reason>`. For remote shipping, add `ship:true` in the admin form.
Marissa L: legal flag: include a consent checkbox for photos and a short data-use blurb when collecting shipping addresses. I'll draft wording.
Ethan Cole: volunteer staffing: need 3 per 2hr shift. asking eng/product for volunteers. also need a lead to handle remote address collection + ticketing.
Sofia Martinez: I'll own the remote queue. will build a Google Form that writes to the event sheet + triggers the people-bot via Zapier. link: https://docs.google.com/forms/event-recog-remote (draft)
Ravi Desai: budget check: suggested $15-25 per quick kudos, $100 for surprise spot awards. if we aim for 60 kudos across weekend at $20 avg = $1,200. approve?
Nina Park: tentatively yes. final approval depends on PO submission. can finance expedite?
people-bot: Finance approval workflow: submit PO to #procurement and tag @JamesR. Use template: `PO: Recognition Sprint - $AMOUNT - VendorName`.
Marissa L: consent text drafted: "I consent to Redwood using my photo for internal and public social channels. I consent to provide shipping address for award redemption." will post in sheet.
Ethan Cole: logistics: need paper ballot box for "shout-out wall" + small backdrop for photos. can facilities help with backdrop?
Sofia Martinez: pinged facilities. also adding a QR on the poster linking to remote form.
Nina Park: timeline: posters printed by Wed; PO submitted by Wed EOD; volunteers confirmed by Thu; test run Fri morning.
Ravi Desai: procurement will need vendor details + tax ID. Sofia please add vendor contact in the sheet.
Sofia Martinez: done. vendor supports CSV for bulk e-gifts. will add sample CSV to the sheet.
people-bot: Event automation set: "recog-reminder" will DM volunteers 24h prior.
Marissa L: also adding a short script for volunteers to read for consent + photo opt-out.
Ethan Cole: can we include a tiny leader board for teams with most kudos? playful only, no public shaming.
Nina Park: yes keep it light. add opt-out for public leaderboard display.
Sofia Martinez: mock poster copy in the doc. Nina will finalize visuals.
Nina Park: action items: Sofia build form + vendor CSV by Tue; Marissa draft consent + script by Tue; Ravi coordinate PO with procurement; Ethan get volunteers; people-bot will handle reminders.
Ravi Desai: cc @JamesR once PO is ready. I'll queue it for expedited review.
Nina Park: thanks team! will close the thread and reopen with any blockers. :sparkles:
